shellCommands.command: echo "--- HOME (empty) ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'Currently Reading|Finished|Nothing in progress|Nothing finished' && echo "--- ADD BOOK ---" && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d 'title=The Hobbit&author=J.R.R. Tolkien&notes=Bilbo goes on an adventure.' -o /dev/null -w "redirect: %{redirect_url}\n" && echo "--- HOME (1 reading) ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'The Hobbit|Currently Reading'

echo "--- DETAIL PAGE ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/326789f8 | grep -E '<h1>|by |Notes|Bilbo|Mark as finished|Share this book|localhost:3000/books/326789f8' && echo "--- MARK FINISHED ---" && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/326789f8/finish -o /dev/null -w "redirect: %{redirect_url}\n" && echo "--- DETAIL (finished badge) ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/326789f8 | grep -E 'Finished|Reading|Mark as finished' && echo "--- HOME (1 finished) ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'The Hobbit|Finished'

echo "--- JSON FILE ---" && cat books.json && echo "--- VALIDATION (empty title) ---" && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d 'title=&author=Nobody&notes=' | grep -E 'error|Title is required' && echo "--- 404 ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/nonexistent | grep -E 'Book not found|does'
